notes: Fee status remains needs_verification: lack of an APC is not proof of free submission or absence of mandatory page charges. AI policy compatibility requires independent journal-specific review. Springer journal guidance requires LLM-use disclosure and distinguishes copyediting from generative work, but this alone does not establish all required permissions: https://link.springer.com/journal/43684/submission-guidelines.

Rejected Journal of Intelligent & Robotic Systems: now fully OA with APC, https://link.springer.com/journal/10846/how-to-publish-with-us. Rejected Nonlinear Dynamics: all submissions from 11 August 2026 subject to APC unless waiver, https://link.springer.com/journal/11071.

IEEE Transactions on Robotics and IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering impose mandatory overlength charges, respectively https://www.ieee-ras.org/publications/t-ro/t-ro-information-for-authors/ and https://www.ieee-ras.org/publications/t-ase/frequently-asked-questions/. Membership, standard length and conference registration require venue-specific verification. No conference route inferred free.
Elsevier journal pages were read via official indexed page content; direct web opening returned 403. Journal-specific AI and all cost conditions remain to be audited.
